[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Meta.Tactic.Simp
import Lean.Meta.Tactic.Rewrite
import Lean.Meta.Tactic.Rename
import Lean.Meta.Tactic.Contradiction
import Lean.Meta.Tactic.Lineararith

def implementation (string: String) (substring: String) : Nat :=
if substring.length = 0 then
  string.length
else
  let rec count_occurrences (idx: Nat) (count: Nat) : Nat :=
    if idx + substring.length > string.length then
      count
    else if substring = string.drop idx.take substring.length then
      count_occurrences (idx + 1) (count + 1)
    else
      count_occurrences (idx + 1) count
  count_occurrences 0 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma implementation_zero_substring
(string: String)
: implementation string "" = string.length
:=
by
simp [implementation]
have h_substring_len_0 := substring.length = 0
simp [h_substring_len_0]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string substring
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]

-- Case 1: substring.length = 0
have h_substring_len_0 := substring.length = 0
simp [h_substring_len_0]
apply And.intro
linarith
apply And.intro
intro h_string_len_lt_0
linarith
have h_string_eq_substring := string = substring
simp [h_string_eq_substring]
linarith
have h_string_neq_substring := string ≠ substring
simp [h_string_neq_substring]
linarith
have h_string_eq_substring := string = substring
simp [h_string_eq_substring]
apply And.intro
linarith
have h_string_neq_substring := string ≠ substring
simp [h_string_neq_substring]
linarith

-- Case 2: substring.length ≠ 0
have h_substring_len_neq_0 := substring.length ≠ 0
simp [h_substring_len_neq_0]
apply And.intro
linarith
apply And.intro
have h_string_len_lt_substring := string.length < substring.length
simp [h_string_len_lt_substring]
linarith
have h_string_len_eq_substring := string.length = substring.length
simp [h_string_len_eq_substring]
have h_string_eq_substring := string = substring
simp [h_string_eq_substring]
linarith
have h_string_neq_substring := string ≠ substring
simp [h_string_neq_substring]
linarith
have h_string_len_eq_substring := string.length = substring.length
simp [h_string_len_eq_substring]
have h_string_eq_substring := string = substring
simp [h_string_eq_substring]
linarith
have h_string_len_eq_substring := string.length = substring.length
simp [h_string_len_eq_substring]
have h_string_neq_substring := string ≠ substring
simp [h_string_neq_substring]
linarith
have h_string_len_eq_substring := string.length = substring.length
simp [h_string_len_eq_substring]
have h_string_eq_substring := string = substring
simp [h_string_eq_substring]
linarith
have h_string_len_eq_substring := string.length = substring.length
simp [h_string_len_eq_substring]
have h_string_neq_substring := string ≠ substring
simp [h_string_neq_substring]
linarith

-- Case 3: substring.length < string.length
have h_substring_len_lt_string := substring.length < string.length
simp [h_substring_len_lt_string]
have h_substring_start_idx := {i: Nat | i < string.length - substring.length + 1}
have h_substring_occurrences := {i ∈ h_substring_start_idx | (string.drop i).take substring.length = substring }
have h_result := result = h_substring_occurrences.toFinset.card
simp [h_result]
linarith
[END]
